blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Accounting is not just about reports. Its real value is helping leaders make better decisions. When the numbers are right, managers can see which products make money, which markets are growing, and where costs are too high.

At Czarnikow, the finance team sends monthly reports to every desk. The trading team uses margin analysis to choose which contracts to pursue. The operations team uses cost reports to negotiate better freight rates. The CEO uses the numbers to decide where to put money.

Financial analysis turns raw data into insight. The best analysts do not just show numbers. They explain what the numbers mean, what changed, and what the business should do next.

items.q: According to the text, what is the real value of accounting?
items.why: "Its real value is helping leaders make better decisions."

items.q: Which team uses margin analysis to choose contracts?
items.why: "The trading team uses margin analysis to choose which contracts to pursue."

items.q: What do the best analysts do, according to the text?
options: Explain what the numbers mean and what to do next
items.why: "They explain what the numbers mean, what changed, and what the business should do next."

items.q: The text suggests that numbers alone are…
options: not very useful without a clear explanation
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que os melhores analistas explicam os números — só os números não bastam.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: Analysts should say what to do next.
Good numbers show where costs are too high.
Accounting is just about producing reports.
items.why: Inferência: o texto começa dizendo que contabilidade NÃO é só produzir relatórios.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James mostrando o P&L a um novo gerente comercial. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, come and sit here. This is last quarter's P&L, and I have split it by product line. Take your time — the numbers are not scary once you know what to look for.

Look at this first line. Sugar is growing fast, and the margin is strong. So this is where we should invest next quarter. I want to push this product, because the market is clearly there.

Now look further down. This product line is flat. The margin is very thin, almost nothing. When you see a weak margin like this, you have to ask a simple question: do we raise prices, or do we cut costs? If we can do neither, maybe we should stop.

And here, this small customer. The number looks quiet, almost silent. But this client pays on time, every time. So we keep them. A safe customer is worth a lot.

Remember one thing. The numbers do not decide for you. You decide. The report only shows you where to look. Good questions turn these numbers into real answers.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How has James organised last quarter's P&L?
items.why: "This is last quarter's P&L, and I have split it by product line."

items.q: Why does James want to invest in sugar next quarter?
options: It is growing fast and the margin is strong
items.why: "Sugar is growing fast, and the margin is strong. So this is where we should invest."

items.q: What does James suggest when a product has a very thin margin?
options: Ask whether to raise prices or cut costs
items.why: "do we raise prices, or do we cut costs? If we can do neither, maybe we should stop."

items.q: Why does James want to keep the small, quiet customer?
options: The client always pays on time
items.why: "this client pays on time, every time. So we keep them." — um cliente seguro vale muito.

items.q: What does James mean by "the numbers do not decide for you"?
options: The person must make the decision, not the report
items.why: Inferência: o relatório mostra onde olhar, mas a decisão é da pessoa — boas perguntas fazem os números falarem.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We use financial analysis to plan next year." Financial analysis means…
options: studying the numbers to make better choices
items.why: Financial analysis = análise financeira: estudar os números para decidir melhor.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Sugar and coffee are two different ___ in our business."
items.why: Product line = linha de produtos; açúcar e café são duas linhas diferentes.

items.q: "This plan is realistic." Realistic means…
items.why: Realistic = realista: possível e sensato, com os pés no chão.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The margin is strong, so we want to ___ this product next quarter."
items.why: To push a product = impulsionar, investir mais nele.

items.q: "The small account looks silent, but it is safe." Here silent means…
items.why: Silent = silencioso; aqui, uma conta discreta que não chama atenção.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs de negócios ligados ao tema. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The CEO has to sign off on the budget." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new report to every desk." To roll out means to…
options: start using it step by step
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva.

items.q: "Two managers pushed back on the new prices." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar.

items.q: "We agreed the plan, but nobody followed through." They…
options: did not finish what was agreed
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "This small change will not move the needle on profit." It means it will…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, fazer diferença perceptível.
